recentItems.title: Girls Aloud - Control Of The Knife (Live From O2 Arena, London, UK / Tangled Up Tour / 2008)
recentItems.description:
'Control Of The Knife' performed live during Girls Aloud’s 'Tangled Up' tour, now remastered to celebrate the iconic album.

To celebrate all things 'Tangled Up' in 2026, Girls Aloud have are releasing a special deluxe edition of the band’s fourth smash hit album, featuring many of Girls Aloud's strongest and most loved tracks including 'Call The Shots', 'Sexy! No No No...' and 'Call The Shots'.

Get yours here: https://GirlsAloud.lnk.to/TangledUpID
 
Tangled Up is widely regarded as one of Girls Aloud’s defining pop albums and a career high-point for the group. Critically acclaimed and packed with fan favourites including “Call The Shots”, “Girl Overboard” and “Control Of The Knife”, Tangled Up cemented Girls Aloud’s reputation as one of the UK’s most innovative and successful pop acts, combining commercial success with some of the strongest reviews of their career.

The 2026 reissue version includes two limited-edition vinyl formats—a 1LP Picture Disc and 1LP Coloured Vinyl—alongside a 3CD Expanded Edition. The 3CD set is the definitive version of the album, featuring five previously unreleased recordings, including two songs that have never been released before from the legendary Brian Higgins of Xenomania “What’s A Girl To Do” and “My Heart”. Also included are three previously unreleased alternative versions and mixes of “Sexy! No No No...”, “Girl Overboard” and “Close To Love”. Completing the package are rare and unseen images from the era alongside brand-new sleeve notes by Nick Levine.

recentItems.title: Girls Aloud - Long Hot Summer (Behind The Scenes)
recentItems.description:
The 'Long Hot Summer' behind-the-scenes video. Now remastered in 1080p to celebrate 20 years of Girls Aloud's ‘Chemistry’.

To celebrate its 20th anniversary in 2025, Girls Aloud are releasing a special deluxe edition of the band’s third smash hit album ‘Chemistry’ this September, featuring many of Girls Aloud's strongest and most loved tracks including 'Biology', 'Whole Lotta History', 'Long Hot Summer' and the band’s cover of 'See The Day'.

Get yours here: https://GirlsAloud.lnk.to/Chemistry20ID
 
The 'Chemistry' 20th anniversary deluxe edition album also contains 4 previously unreleased tracks from the Girls Aloud vaults. Alongside 'Singapore', the album includes 'Naked In the Shower', a track that hints at the dancier direction the band were moving towards, 'You Go Too Fast (Demo)'  originally written (although not included) for the 'Herbie: Fully Loaded' movie soundtrack and 'Watch Me Go (We’re Disco)' an alternate version of the Chemistry album track featuring a new intro and an extra middle eight section.
